title: Premiere's keys work on the timeline
goal: A Premiere editor reaches for J/K/L, I/O, B, V, arrows, Cmd-K and gets nothing (only B for blade exists). Target: the user's mocks (docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html, video-shell.html, comp-video.html and the page named here) at their fidelity; runner-prompt rules on default config, side-by-side with the mock, labels-not-explanations and right-click apply. Ask throughout: would a Premiere editor get this, and is it easier here?
notes: Filed from the 2026-09-23 video audit in the intake window.
acceptance: Space play/pause; J/K/L shuttle with repeated J/L speeding up; K+J/L inching
I/O set in and out, Opt-I/O clear; Cmd-K split at playhead; Delete lift, Shift-Delete ripple
Left/Right one frame, Shift+arrows five frames, Up/Down previous/next edit point, Home/End
V select, B blade, A track select forward; = and - zoom, backslash fit
Where a Photoshop key conflicts, the timeline wins only while the timeline has focus; documented in the shortcuts sheet
